content:
# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket + RDS + IAM

This implements a `WebAppInfra` composite resource using **Crossplane functions mode** (`function-patch-and-transform`). Environment separation (dev/prod) is achieved via composition parameters + per-environment claims.

## Directory Layout

```
crossplane/
├── functions.yaml            # function-patch-and-transform install
├── providers.yaml            # AWS provider families
├── xrd.yaml                  # CompositeResourceDefinition
├── composition.yaml          # Composition (functions mode)
└── claims/
    ├── dev.yaml
    └── prod.yaml
```

---

## 1. Function + Providers

```yaml
# functions.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
```

```yaml
# providers.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-s3
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-s3:v1.14.0
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-rds
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-rds:v1.14.0
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-iam
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-iam:v1.14.0
```

---

## 2. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xwebappinfras.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XWebAppInfra
    plural: xwebappinfras
  claimNames:
    kind: WebAppInfra
    plural: webappinfras
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: webappinfra-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - parameters
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - namePrefix
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - dbSubnetGroup
                    - dbPasswordSecretRef
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    region:
                      type: string
                    namePrefix:
                      type: string
                      description: Prefix for all resource names.
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: EKS OIDC provider ARN for IRSA trust.
                    oidcSubject:
                      type: string
                      description: "system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa> subject."
                      default: "system:serviceaccount:default:webapp"
                    # DB sizing driven by env, but overridable
                    dbInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro
                    dbMultiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    dbStorageEncrypted:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    dbSubnetGroup:
                      type: string
                    dbPasswordSecretRef:
                      type: object
                      description: Secret containing masterPassword (never in Git).
                      required: [name, namespace, key]
                      properties:
                        name: { type: string }
                        namespace: { type: string }
                        key: { type: string }
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                irsaRoleArn:
                  type: string
```

---

## 3. Composition (functions mode)

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: webappinfra-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebAppInfra
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # S3 BUCKET
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-assets"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.id
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName

          # Versioning enabled  (AC #1)
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # Server-side encryption AES-256 (AC #1)
          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # Block ALL public access (AC #1 – no public access)
          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # RDS POSTGRESQL
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: rds-postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15"
                  username: appadmin
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  # AC #2 – deletion protection ON
                  deletionProtection: true
                  # AC #2 – backups >= 7 days
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 14
                  # AC #2 – not publicly accessible
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: webapp-final-snapshot
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  applyImmediately: false
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    key: password
                    name: placeholder
                    namespace: crossplane-system
            connectionDetails:
              - name: endpoint
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
              - name: port
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbMultiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbStorageEncrypted
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbSubnetGroup
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-postgres"
              # Pull master password from a K8s Secret (never in Git – AC #3)
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # IAM ROLE FOR SERVICE ACCOUNT (IRSA) — least privilege
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  # Trust policy patched below (OIDC federation)
                  assumeRolePolicy: ""
            connectionDetails: []
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-webapp-irsa"
              # Build OIDC assume-role trust policy from provider ARN + subject
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcSubject
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [{
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": {"Federated": "%s"},
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                          "Condition": {
                            "StringEquals": {
                              "%s:sub": "%s"
                            }
                          }
                        }]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                # NB: the provider ARN appears twice because the OIDC audience/sub
                # condition key is derived from the same provider host.

          # Least-privilege inline policy: scoped S3 access to the app bucket only
          - name: irsa-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policy: ""
            patches:
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    # No wildcard actions (AC #4). Scoped to this bucket ARN.
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [{
                          "Sid": "AppBucketAccess",
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObject",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:DeleteObject",
                            "s3:ListBucket"
                          ],
                          "Resource": [
                            "arn:aws:s3:::%s-app-assets",
                            "arn:aws:s3:::%s-app-assets/*"
                          ]
                        }]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy

    # Auto-detect readiness of all composed resources
    - step: auto-ready
      functionRef:
        name: function-auto-ready
```

> Add the auto-ready function if you want automatic readiness propagation:
> ```yaml
> # functions.yaml (append)
> apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
> kind: Function
> metadata:
>   name: function-auto-ready
> spec:
>   package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.4.0
> ```

---

## 4. Claims (Environment Isolation — AC #7)

Each environment is an independent claim in its own namespace. Changing `prod` never touches `dev` state.

```yaml
# claims/dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: WebAppInfra
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-dev
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEKS
    oidcSubject: "system:serviceaccount:default:webapp"
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    dbMultiAZ: false
    dbStorageEncrypted: false
    dbSubnetGroup: dev-db-subnets
    dbPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-master-dev          # created out-of-band; SOPS/ESO, never plaintext in Git
      namespace: dev
      key: password
```

```yaml
# claims/prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: WebAppInfra
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-prod
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::444455556666:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEKS
    oidcSubject: "system:serviceaccount:default:webapp"
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    dbMultiAZ: true                 # multi-AZ for prod
    dbStorageEncrypted: true        # encrypted for prod
    dbSubnetGroup: prod-db-subnets
    dbPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-master-prod
      namespace: prod
      key: password
```

---

## Acceptance Criteria Mapping

| AC | Where satisfied |
|----|-----------------|
| **#1 Bucket** | `BucketVersioning` (Enabled), `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all true) |
| **#2 RDS** | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 14`, `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **#3 Secret** | DB password sourced from a K8s Secret via `passwordSecretRef` — provisioned via SOPS/External-Secrets, never committed |
| **#4 IAM** | Enumerated S3 actions scoped to the bucket ARN; no `"*"` actions/resources |
| **#7 Isolation** | Independent claims per namespace/account; separate managed-resource state trees |

---

## Notes on Secrets (AC #3)

The RDS master password is **never** in Git. Provide the referenced Secret via one of:

- **External Secrets Operator** pulling from AWS Secrets Manager / Vault, or
- **SOPS-encrypted** Secret decrypted at apply-time in your GitOps pipeline.

Example ESO stub (secret material stays in the external store):

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: rds-master-prod
  namespace: prod
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    name: aws-secretsmanager
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: rds-master-prod
  data:
    - secretKey: password
      remoteRef:
        key: prod/webapp/rds-master
```

Cluster (EKS), CloudFront/ACM HTTPS, and cross-region replication belong to sibling compositions (EKS uses `provider-aws-eks`; CDN uses `provider-aws-cloudfront`) — the three resources requested here are complete and independently deployable per environment.
